check_connection.title: Check the connection
check_connection.description: Verify the AppFollow API token works by listing the account's users (1 credit). Use list_users to filter by id or email.

list_users.title: List users
list_users.description: List the users in your AppFollow account, optionally filtered by user id or email. Costs 1 credit.

id.description: Only the user with this id.

email.description: Only the user with this email.

add_user.title: Add a user
add_user.description: Invite a user to your AppFollow account with a role and, optionally, the collections (workspaces) they can access. Advanced/Custom API plans only; 1 credit.

collections.description: Comma-separated collection ids the user can access, e.g. 1,2,3.

update_user.title: Update a user
update_user.description: Update an AppFollow user's name, email, role and accessible collections by user id. Advanced/Custom API plans only; 1 credit.

collections.description: Comma-separated collection ids the user can access.

remove_user.title: Remove a user
remove_user.description: Remove a user from your AppFollow account by user id. Advanced/Custom API plans only; 1 credit.

email.description: User's email, as an extra filter.

list_collections.title: List collections
list_collections.description: List the app collections (workspaces) in your AppFollow account with their ids and names - needed for collection_name and apps_id elsewhere. 1 credit.

add_collection.title: Add a collection
add_collection.description: Create an app collection (workspace) with its countries, default country and optional email report schedules. Advanced/Custom API plans only; 1 credit.

email.description: Email for reports; required if any report schedule is set.

app_updates.description: Timeline report schedule(s): daily, weekly, monthly, comma-separated.

remove_collection.title: Remove a collection
remove_collection.description: Delete an app collection (workspace) by id, with its tracked apps. Advanced/Custom API plans only; 1 credit.

list_collection_apps.title: List apps in a collection
list_collection_apps.description: List the apps tracked in one collection, with their store, external id and details. 1 credit.

add_app.title: Add an app to a collection
add_app.description: Start tracking a store app in a collection. Advanced/Custom API plans only; 1 credit.

store.description: Store code, e.g. as or gp.

ext_id.description: App external id in its store: the App Store numeric id (e.g. 1038369065) or Google Play package name.

remove_app.title: Remove an app from a collection
remove_app.description: Stop tracking an app in a collection. Advanced/Custom API plans only; 1 credit.

store.description: Store code, e.g. as or gp.

ext_id.description: App external id in its store: the App Store numeric id (e.g. 1038369065) or Google Play package name.

list_reviews.title: List reviews
list_reviews.description: Get store reviews for one app (ext_id) or a whole collection (collection_name) within a date range, filtered by country, language, text, review id, custom status or last-modified time. Paginated. 10 credits.

ext_id.description: App external id in its store: the App Store numeric id (e.g. 1038369065) or Google Play package name.

collection_name.description: Collection name; either this or ext_id is required.

custom_status.description: Custom statuses, comma-separated, e.g. open,reopened (needs the Review Status feature).

last_modified.description: Only reviews modified since, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

get_reviews_summary.title: Get reviews summary
get_reviews_summary.description: Summarize an app's reviews - counts and rating breakdown - optionally by country, language, version and date range. 10 credits plus 10 per 30 days of range.
get_reviews_summary.notes: AppFollow API credits per call: 10 (+10 per 30 days).

ext_id.description: App external id in its store: the App Store numeric id (e.g. 1038369065) or Google Play package name.

get_reviews_ai_summary.title: Get AI reviews summary
get_reviews_ai_summary.description: Get an AI-written summary of what reviewers say about an app over a date range, per store and countries. 10 credits.

ext_id.description: App external id in its store: the App Store numeric id (e.g. 1038369065) or Google Play package name.

store.description: Store code: as (App Store), gp (Google Play), ms, am, mc or xs.

list_featured_reviews.title: List featured reviews
list_featured_reviews.description: Get an app's featured (most helpful) reviews, optionally by country, language, custom status and date range. 10 credits.

ext_id.description: App external id in its store: the App Store numeric id (e.g. 1038369065) or Google Play package name.

get_review_semantic_tags.title: Get review semantic tags
get_review_semantic_tags.description: Get AI semantic tagging of an app's reviews - topics and sentiment - filtered by language, rating, sentiment, tag, version and dates. Advanced/Custom API plans only; 100 credits.

ext_id.description: App external id in its store: the App Store numeric id (e.g. 1038369065) or Google Play package name.

reply_to_review.title: Reply to a review
reply_to_review.description: Post a public developer reply to a store review. The reply is published to the store. 10 credits.

ext_id.description: App external id in its store: the App Store numeric id (e.g. 1038369065) or Google Play package name.

login.description: API user login shown in the reviews list (private beta).

update_review_tags.title: Set review tags
update_review_tags.description: Set the AppFollow tags on a review (comma-separated names). 10 credits.

ext_id.description: App external id in its store: the App Store numeric id (e.g. 1038369065) or Google Play package name.

update_review_bug_trackers.title: Set review bug tracker tags
update_review_bug_trackers.description: Link a review to bug tracker tickets by setting bug tracker tags with a prefix, e.g. OTRS-001,OTRS-002. 1 credit.

ext_id.description: App external id in its store: the App Store numeric id (e.g. 1038369065) or Google Play package name.

tags.description: Bug tracker tags, comma-separated, e.g. OTRS-001.

update_review_note.title: Set a review note
update_review_note.description: Set an internal AppFollow note on a review (not visible in the store). 10 credits.

ext_id.description: App external id in its store: the App Store numeric id (e.g. 1038369065) or Google Play package name.

set_review_status.title: Set review custom status
set_review_status.description: Set a review's custom status to reopened or closed (private beta; needs the Review Status feature).

ext_id.description: App external id in its store: the App Store numeric id (e.g. 1038369065) or Google Play package name.

report_review_concern.title: Report a review concern
report_review_concern.description: Report a review to the store as a concern (e.g. Spam) with an explanation. Advanced/Custom API plans only; 10 credits.

store.description: Store in long format, e.g. googleplay.

ext_id.description: App external id in its store: the App Store numeric id (e.g. 1038369065) or Google Play package name.

concern_explanation.description: Why the review is a concern.

upload_reviews.title: Upload custom-source reviews
upload_reviews.description: Upload reviews from your own source (support tickets, surveys, other stores) into the AppFollow reviews feed for tagging and summarisation. Each review needs ext_review_id, content_raw and ext_created_at; optional author_id, author_name, normal_rating (0-5), lang, parent_id, extra. Advanced/Custom API plans only.

ext_id.description: Your unique idempotency key for this batch, e.g. batch_2025-10-24_42.

on_conflict.description: What to do with already-uploaded ext_review_ids (default error).

get_review_stats.title: Get review statistics
get_review_stats.description: Get review counts and statistics for an app over a date range. 10 credits per 30 days of range.
get_review_stats.notes: AppFollow API credits per call: 10 per 30 days.

ext_id.description: App external id in its store: the App Store numeric id (e.g. 1038369065) or Google Play package name.

get_review_rating_stats.title: Get review rating statistics
get_review_rating_stats.description: Get the star-rating breakdown of an app's reviews for a day, optionally for one replying user. 10 credits.

ext_id.description: App external id in its store: the App Store numeric id (e.g. 1038369065) or Google Play package name.

get_review_version_stats.title: Get review statistics by version
get_review_version_stats.description: Get review statistics broken down by app version, optionally for one version, country, language and day. 10 credits.

ext_id.description: App external id in its store: the App Store numeric id (e.g. 1038369065) or Google Play package name.

get_reply_stats.title: Get review reply statistics
get_reply_stats.description: Get statistics on replies to an app's reviews for a day or date range, optionally for one replying user. 10 credits plus 10 per day.
get_reply_stats.notes: AppFollow API credits per call: 10 (+10 per day).

ext_id.description: App external id in its store: the App Store numeric id (e.g. 1038369065) or Google Play package name.

get_reply_speed_stats.title: Get reply speed statistics
get_reply_speed_stats.description: Get how quickly an app's reviews were replied to on a day, optionally for one replying user. 10 credits.

ext_id.description: App external id in its store: the App Store numeric id (e.g. 1038369065) or Google Play package name.

get_reply_counts.title: Count review replies
get_reply_counts.description: Count replies posted to an app's reviews over a date range, optionally by API user login. 10 credits plus 10 per day.
get_reply_counts.notes: AppFollow API credits per call: 10 (+10 per day).

ext_id.description: App external id in its store: the App Store numeric id (e.g. 1038369065) or Google Play package name.

get_ratings_history.title: Get ratings history
get_ratings_history.description: Get an app's store ratings over time - daily, weekly, monthly or quarterly - as totals or diffs, per country, with offset/limit paging. 10 credits plus 10 per 30 days.
get_ratings_history.notes: AppFollow API credits per call: 10 (+10 per 30 days).

store.description: Store code: as (App Store), gp (Google Play), ms, am, mc or xs.

ext_id.description: App external id in its store: the App Store numeric id (e.g. 1038369065) or Google Play package name.

countries.description: Country code(s); all gives worldwide data for as and gp with type total.

country.description: Single country code (countries takes priority; discouraged).

type.description: total for the ratings count on each date, diff for changes between dates.

get_google_play_console_ratings.title: Get Google Play Console ratings
get_google_play_console_ratings.description: Get ratings or users data from the Google Play Console for an app over time (choose ratings or users, not both). 10 credits plus 10 per 30 days.
get_google_play_console_ratings.notes: AppFollow API credits per call: 10 (+10 per 30 days).

ext_id.description: App external id in its store: the App Store numeric id (e.g. 1038369065) or Google Play package name.

list_app_versions.title: List app versions
list_app_versions.description: List an app's version history in a country, including any metadata changes (title, description, screenshots...). Set unique to 1 for distinct versions only. 10 credits.

ext_id.description: App external id in its store: the App Store numeric id (e.g. 1038369065) or Google Play package name.

unique.description: 1 to return unique versions only, 0 otherwise.

list_whats_new.title: List what's new
list_whats_new.description: List an app's release notes (what's new) for each new version, optionally since a last-modified time. 10 credits.

ext_id.description: App external id in its store: the App Store numeric id (e.g. 1038369065) or Google Play package name.

last_modified.description: Only entries modified since, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

get_top_charts.title: Get public top charts
get_top_charts.description: Get a store's public top chart for a country, device, genre and date. 10 credits.

get_rankings.title: Get app rankings
get_rankings.description: Get an app's category chart positions, optionally by country, device, genre and date. 10 credits.

ext_id.description: App external id in its store: the App Store numeric id (e.g. 1038369065) or Google Play package name.

get_featured_apps.title: Get App Store featurings
get_featured_apps.description: Get where an App Store app was featured (by feature type) in a country and date range. 10 credits plus 10 per 30 days.
get_featured_apps.notes: AppFollow API credits per call: 10 (+10 per 30 days).

ext_id.description: App external id in its store: the App Store numeric id (e.g. 1038369065) or Google Play package name.

research_keyword.title: Research ASO keyword suggestions
research_keyword.description: Get store search suggestions for a keyword in a country and device - for ASO keyword research. 5 credits.

search_store.title: Search the store (ASO)
search_store.description: Get the store search results for a keyword in a country and device - which apps rank for it. 10 credits.

list_keywords.title: List tracked keywords
list_keywords.description: List an app's tracked ASO keywords with positions for a country, device and date (default today). Paginated. 10 credits.

ext_id.description: App external id in its store: the App Store numeric id (e.g. 1038369065) or Google Play package name.

edit_keywords.title: Edit tracked keywords
edit_keywords.description: Set the tracked ASO keywords for a country and device in a collection (the first collection when apps_id is omitted). 5 credits.

apps_id.description: Collection id; defaults to the first.

get_search_ads_keyword_recommendations.title: Get Search Ads keyword recommendations
get_search_ads_keyword_recommendations.description: Get Apple Search Ads keyword recommendations for an app name, optionally seeded with a phrase and country. 10 credits.

get_aso_report.title: Get downloads report
get_aso_report.description: Get an app's downloads (from connected store accounts) by source channel or as a time series, per country, date range and period. 10 credits.

ext_id.description: App external id in its store: the App Store numeric id (e.g. 1038369065) or Google Play package name.

channel.description: channel for downloads by source channel, time_series for totals.

get_google_play_acquisition_report.title: Get Google Play acquisition report
get_google_play_acquisition_report.description: Get a Google Play Developer Console acquisition report for an app by channel (all, search, explore, 3rdparty) over a date range. 10 credits.

ext_id.description: App external id in its store: the App Store numeric id (e.g. 1038369065) or Google Play package name.

get_search_ads_report.title: Get App Store Search Ads report
get_search_ads_report.description: Get an app's Apple Search Ads report over a date range; with country=all and report_type=breakdown it breaks down by country. 10 credits.

ext_id.description: App external id in its store: the App Store numeric id (e.g. 1038369065) or Google Play package name.

report_type.description: breakdown for a per-country report when country is all.
